summary: Quartz Mountain Resources Ltd., a Canadian gold and silver explorer listed by SEC CIK 0000811522, furnished a Form 6-K dated September 23, 2026, whose only substantive exhibit is a press release (Exhibit 99.1), signed by CFO Sebastian Tang. The excerpt contains no transaction terms, no stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date; the balance is boilerplate cover-page, signature, and encoded image data. No special-situation event is disclosed here, so the filing maps to a routine foreign-private-issuer current report with nothing for a risk-arb angle to act on.
